hook: Clip a long story in 3 moves

items.title: Cut the backstory
items.say: One. Cut most of the backstory.

items.title: Keep the turn
items.say: Two. Keep the moment it turns.

items.title: End on the punchline
items.say: Three. End right on the punchline.
